changes.after: A function is a named set of instructions you can use again.

before: A function is a named group of instructions that can be called with inputs. A parameter is the input name inside the function.
function doubleScore($n) declares a function with parameter $n. doubleScore(4) calls it with argument 4.
return gives a result back to the caller and ends that function call. Returning is different from displaying with echo.
Each call uses its own supplied value. Defining the function does not run its body yet.
Expected result: 8. Follow the instructions in order; this is a worked example, not an in-app execution.
after: A function is a named set of instructions you can use again.
The number in the call takes the place of the name n inside the function.
Give the caller the result of multiplying the input by two.
The output is `8`. The call supplies four, so the function gives back eight.
Give the same function a different input.
